description: The dataset author publishes four GNSS interference recordings collected in Narva and Tallinn, Estonia. Zenodo offers the series as a ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The description identifies a u-blox receiver and active antenna, two Narva collection positions near the eastern border, and two distinct Tallinn baseline recordings. Tallinn-2 supplies clean normaliser and threshold training, while Tallinn-1 is held out for clean evaluation. These signals can test interference-detection and satellite-positioning resilience methods. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these four recordings. Coverage is the chosen receiver sites and campaign periods, not nationwide interference prevalence. A limitation is that the public summary does not establish a verified source for interference events, channel conditions or a label protocol. The ZIP was not downloaded; sample rate, internal file encoding and independent detector scores remain unchecked.
